hero.title: Lottery intelligence with clear feature routes, consistent read models, and API-ready UI contracts
hero.description: This home page pulls copy, feature summaries, metrics, and product preview content from JSON so the team can revise the marketing surface quickly while keeping the UI aligned with the production dashboard.

metrics.label: Product feature pages
metrics.hint: One route per primary product surface.

metrics.label: Mock draw coverage
metrics.hint: Simulated draw count used by analytics and backtest surfaces.

featureSection.title: One route per primary user workflow

features.title: Dashboard
features.description: Latest draw, top signals, hot/cold/overdue movement, and prediction summary in one overview surface.

features.title: Results
features.description: Historical results with filters for draw history, grouped prizes, and number lookup workflows.

features.title: Analytics
features.description: Digit and number frequency, position bias, last-seen timing, and missing-draw counts.

features.title: Patterns
features.description: Odd/even, high/low, double, sequence, mirrored-number, and seasonal pattern views.

features.title: Prediction Lab
features.description: Generate candidate numbers with score breakdowns, reasons, and result inspection flow.

features.title: Backtest
features.description: Test strategy performance with hit rate, miss streak, and persisted run history.

features.title: Compare
features.description: Compare multiple candidate numbers with shared score breakdown, hotness, and overdue support.

features.title: Calendar
features.description: Draw calendar, next-draw countdown, and monthly insight summaries with uncertainty framing.

workflow.title: Mock data stays centralized
workflow.description: Home reads JSON directly, and downstream feature pages should continue using shared mock read models instead of scattering copy across many files.

workflow.title: User-facing routes first
workflow.description: Admin screens and bulk import tooling are kept out of the user product surface so research workflows stay focused on draws, analytics, and predictions.

workflow.title: API contracts can slot in later
workflow.description: Entity names and module boundaries already align to draws, analytics, and predictions so Elysia and Prisma wiring can replace the fixtures cleanly.

trustPanel.label: Responsible prediction
trustPanel.title: Candidate numbers need reasons, not implied guarantees
trustPanel.description: Every score in the dashboard should be explained as a historical signal derived from frequency, recency, position support, and backtest context, with a clear limitation statement alongside it.
